ios.desc:
Three small things to do each week, out in the real world.

Every Monday morning, Kwesti gives you three side quests. Watch the light change at sunset. Leave a kind note for someone. Listen to a song you loved at sixteen. Some take five minutes, some take an afternoon. None of them need your phone for long.

How it works
Swipe up or down to see this week's three.
Swipe right to live one. The camera opens so you can take a photo while you're doing it, or skip the photo if you'd rather.
Swipe left to swap one that doesn't suit you. You get one swap a week.
Each one you live becomes a print, with your photo, the date, the place and a line in your own words if you want to add one.

Your year, kept
Your prints collect in Journey, week by week, into a quiet record of a year you actually lived. Turn a print over to see why that one was in your week.

Built to be put down
There are no streaks to protect and no feed to scroll. Miss a week and nothing breaks. Take a rest week whenever you need one. Kwesti sends one note on Monday when your new three arrive, and only if you ask for it.

Yours, and only yours
There's no account to make. Your prints are kept on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud, where nobody else can see them, including us. No ads and no tracking.

What the kwests are about
A year of them, shaped around a few simple ideas: noticing the world around you, being kind to the people in it, getting back into your body, making something with your hands, and spending a little time with your own thoughts.

Share a print, if you like
Every print can be shared as a clean card for a story or a post. Or keep it to yourself.

Made by a human, for fellow humans. If something isn't right, or you have an idea for a kwest, write to me from Settings. I read every message.
